Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
Mjminker wrote:

> after playing golcand ip on a vampire and removing him from the game, can the
> same vampire be influenced out again from the uncontrolled region,

Yes. Vampires being removed from play/burned/Golcondaed/diablerized/whatever
has no effect on bringing the same vampire out again later--a common old
deck type involved a crypt of nothing but Anson; bring out Anson, Minion Tap
Anson, Golconda Anson, bring out Anson again, and so on. You can burn the
same vampire over and over again if you want, and just keep bringing them
out.

> can you use huitzilopochtli's game text more than once during the master phase

I'm fairly certain that by default, any effect that says "Pay X to do Y" can
only be done once per turn. Unless it says otherwise.
